prompt_segment: STEP 1 — FREELANCEMAP PUBLIC PROJECT SEARCH.
Open https://www.freelancermap.com/projects in the Browser Use browser, using the public Projects search page.
Inspect and clear any preselected filters or chips incompatible with the following exact scope, including any geographic exclusion.
Workplace: select ONLY Remote. Explicitly unselect Hybrid and On-site. Do not infer remote eligibility merely from an advertisement title containing the word Remote.
Contract type: select ONLY Freelance. Do not select Permanent or Agency contract.
Countries: ALL countries. Do not choose a country filter. Turn OFF 'Exclude projects from German speaking countries' if it is enabled. Germany, Austria, and Switzerland are included.

Do NOT add other search filters: no keywords, publication date, industry, professional field, direct-client-only, or any additional exclusion. Do not force a particular sorting option; keep the site's default.
Verify the actual active controls/chips after applying the filters. If any required control is unavailable or the page behaves unexpectedly, report the discrepancy instead of claiming success.
Treat filtered results as potential remote/freelance listings, not as globally eligible opportunities: eligibility comes from later, separately approved stages.

Stop this stage after verifying and reporting the effective filters, without collecting listings, reading full details, saving records, applying, or contacting anyone. Later stages, once approved and combined, may add those actions.
verification_outputs: Remote selected, Hybrid and On-site not selected

requirements.stop_condition: Reach the actual last publicly accessible search results page for the approved active filter state; do not infer a complete crawl from a single page.
requirements.capture_scope: ALL search-result listings seen across every accessible results page matching approved filters, including listings previously seen; no relevance/skills/budget filtering at this stage.
requirements.on_first_run: Build the site's local baseline collection and distinguish distinct IDs within the run.
requirements.on_later_runs: Compare each captured listing against the site's previously persisted local records; mark NEW if unseen before, SEEN if already present; preserve the previous collection for future comparisons.
requirements.duplicate_identity: Site + stable project/listing ID when available, otherwise site + canonical project URL; this reuses the existing Opportunity Hunter dedup policy, not a new global rule.
requirements.existing_local_project_home_hint: Existing DJMRN OpportunityHunter local installation has been used; determine the actual site-specific local folder during implementation without modifying unrelated data.
requirements.record_fields: Retain available stable listing ID/URL, shown title and original available listing result data, capture timestamp, page/source references, and NEW/SEEN status. Preserve raw source evidence for later stage 3 without inventing unavailable fields.
requirements.safe_repeat: Use durable saved records as the source for NEW/SEEN, not agent conversational memory; avoid accidental overwriting or erasing earlier run data.
requirements.reporting_end_of_stage: Total visible pages navigated, total captured records, unique identifiers, NEW count, SEEN count, local save/readback outcome, and whether all accessible pages were reached; if not, state PARTIAL and reason.
requirements.stage_boundary: Do not apply suitability rules, reject/screen, read full detail pages, communicate with employers or alter accounts; stage 3 will be separately owner-defined.

bounded_real_world_safeguards.source_note: Freelancermap conditions §4 require appropriate use and prohibit overloading the infrastructure; a full unlimited crawl's permitted rate/scale is not verified.
bounded_real_world_safeguards.hard_guards: Use normal public browser navigation only; no restriction bypass, login, captcha solving, bulk parallelization, or high-frequency requests. Respect access restrictions, service limits and errors.
bounded_real_world_safeguards.completeness: ALL means all accessible filtered listings if technically permitted and reachable. If pages/rate limits/blockers prevent completing, save already collected local records and report PARTIAL/blocked without claiming all pages completed.
bounded_real_world_safeguards.preflight_required_before_full_real_run: Verify permitted access/usage limits, operational cost/quota of Codex subscription, true Windows output path and write ability with a small real test first. No paid APIs or subscription upgrades.
bounded_real_world_safeguards.current_website_terms_assessment: Official terms located; automated full-scan permission/rate not verified, so NO_UNBOUNDED_EXECUTION_YET

approved_session_stage.stage_name: Capture and locally persist all public search result listings; recognize new vs seen on subsequent runs
prompt_segment: STEP 2 — FREELANCEMAP RESULTS COLLECTION AND LOCAL HISTORY.
Proceed only after Step 1's Remote-only + Freelance-only filtered search has been verified, with ALL countries included and no additional filters.

Navigate through EVERY available, publicly accessible search-results page for that filtered search, following normal site pagination until the actual last accessible page. Do not impose an arbitrary page-count limit or skip pages.
Extract ALL listings shown in those result pages, including ones already found in an earlier run; do not screen them for fit or read their full detail pages yet.

Persist the collected raw listing results on the user's Windows computer in an isolated, site-specific FREELANCEMAP folder/profile, not GitHub or another website's records. The final exact Windows folder and file format require separate user confirmation during implementation.

Reuse the existing site's local baseline from previous runs, if available; identify listings by freelancermap project ID or canonical URL, mark NEW vs SEEN, and do not erase or overwrite older saved data.
Record run-time evidence: filtered search URL/state, page references, timestamp, visible listing fields and identifiers, per-run totals, and saved-data verification.
Report visited pages, total captured, distinct/new/seen listings, exact verified local save path and whether all accessible pages were covered.

If loading is blocked, pages are inaccessible, service throttles, permission/rate restrictions arise, or Codex usage is exhausted, stop safely, preserve already-saved progress, and report PARTIAL with the exact blocker. No bypass, retry storm, or false claim of 100% completeness.
Do NOT perform Stage 3 suitability filtering, open every detail page, apply, message, submit or change accounts. Stage 3 will be defined and approved separately.
